snippet.title: Nice Day for Fishing | Xbox Console Announcement
snippet.description:
Embark on an epic RPG adventure from Viva La Dirt League's world of Honeywood. Something extraordinary has happened to Baelin, a very ordinary NPC. Battle fish, cast powerful spells and save Honeywood from the evils cursing the waters.  Coming soon to Xbox.
